SECRET_KEY.description: Secret used to sign login tokens. Auto-generated during install.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database used by Vikunja.

PGDATA.description: Data directory inside the container. Do not change.

VIKUNJA_DATABASE_TYPE.description: Database backend. Vikunja supports postgres, mysql, and sqlite.

VIKUNJA_DATABASE_HOST.description: Hostname of the PostgreSQL server. Auto-configured during install.

VIKUNJA_SERVICE_JWTSECRET.description: Secret used to sign login tokens. Auto-generated during install.

VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL.description: Public URL where Vikunja is reachable. Used in emails and by the frontend.

VIKUNJA_SERVICE_TIMEZONE.description: Timezone for due dates and reminders (e.g. America/New_York).

setup-info.content: On first visit, you'll see a registration form. Create an account to get started — the first registered user becomes the admin.
